findings.title: Curl piped straight into a shell
findings.definition: A remote payload is fetched and executed without inspection — the classic supply-chain injection.
findings.remediation: Pin a versioned download, verify its checksum, then run an inspected file — never pipe remote content to an interpreter.

judged.explanation: The flagged `curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash` line sits in the publisher's own GitHub Actions workflow (CI setup installing the Cursor CLI), not in the MCP server runtime that agents execute. Publisher CI plumbing is outside the artifact's blast radius.
